Underwhelming
Dec 2019 • Family
Had read some gushing reviews, so was excited to go to Aummee, especially as vegetarian options at regular restaurants in Hanoi were getting a bit repetitive. The menu here is certainly extensive, but perhaps they should narrow it down so that guests have a higher chance of making a pleasing choice. Our group of four hit about 50% success.

The staff were either inexperienced or over-worked: we struggled to get service for most of the night, and the dishes were served in apparently random order. Two of us received our main courses before our starters, and my daughter didn’t receive either of her courses until after everyone else had finished theirs (luckily she shared some of ours in the meantime).

The other thing you should know about Aummee is that it has rules for guests, one of which is no loud talking. This was quite a challenge for our family...!

YOU MUST EAT HERE!!!
Oct 2019
A bhuddist restaurant with an ambience to match.
In the 14 days in Hanoi I ate here 3 times (we only discovered this on the 6th day).
With all the meals being vegetarian i was anticipating something rather bland but I could not have been further from the reality.
I think I tried at least a mouthful of everything on this menu - nothing was bland, I cannot believe I have never tried food like this before. Not sure how i am going to cope going back to ham sandwiches now I'm back in the U.K.
You will fill be full when you leave but not fell stodgy - all at great price.
Thank you for a great experience!
